scope.current_docs_platform: MkDocs Material with project-local Python, Node, Vale, link/secret, Mermaid and audit/SBOM tooling

decision_summary.current_stack_policy: Keep the G1.1 documentation toolchain MkDocs-centered until concrete platform trigger evidence exists.

trigger_evidence_required: A React or MDX-heavy documentation experience is required by an accepted Product-Agent OS docs requirement.
Versioned documentation, plugin ecosystem, or docs-app routing needs exceed the current MkDocs Material route.
A migration or coexistence decision record names affected pages, i18n impact, source ownership, rollback and publication boundary.
platform_trigger_records.proposed_project_local_install_folder: .docs-tools/node/ for package management; prototype output under .docs-tools/reports/docusaurus-prototype/ until source adoption is approved
acceptance_criteria: Owner-approved platform decision record exists before install.
Prototype build evidence is recorded without replacing MkDocs source ownership.
MkDocs/site freshness and Docusaurus publication readiness remain separate claims.

trigger_evidence_required: A Product-Agent OS UI component library, generated artifact component system, or reusable interactive documentation surface exists.
Component states, visual QA, accessibility review, or interaction examples need a dedicated component documentation runner.
A component ownership map names source components, stories, fixtures, test data privacy and visual proof boundaries.
platform_trigger_records.proposed_project_local_install_folder: .docs-tools/node/ for package management; static proof output under .docs-tools/reports/storybook-static/ until source adoption is approved
acceptance_criteria: Owner-approved component documentation need exists before install.
Storybook static output is treated as documentation or visual evidence, not runtime proof by itself.
verification_gate_if_triggered: visual/a11y evidence or explicit accepted gap

trigger_evidence_required: Architecture documentation requires a model-driven C4/system landscape source rather than Mermaid-only diagrams.
Multiple systems, containers, relationships, deployment views, or ADR-linked architecture decisions need a governed architecture-as-code model.
A model ownership record names source files, diagram consumers, render checks, review owner and rollback path.
platform_trigger_records.proposed_project_local_install_folder: .docs-tools/bin/ for any approved local CLI/JAR wrapper; model/render outputs under .docs-tools/reports/structurizr/ until source adoption is approved
acceptance_criteria: Owner-approved architecture-as-code need exists before install.
Model source remains separate from generated diagrams and rendered views.
Rendered diagrams are not treated as proof without source and current render evidence.

owner_decision_path: Record a concrete requirement or accepted owner need.
Create a short platform decision record naming trigger evidence, affected files, proposed local install path, rollback and verification.
Request explicit approval for any install/download/scaffold/browser/publication action.
Run only the approved local smoke checks and update source registry/control-plane evidence.
supported_claims: DOC-M41 records trigger criteria for deferred documentation platforms and architecture tooling.
Docusaurus, Storybook and Structurizr DSL remain deferred until concrete trigger evidence exists.
The current G1.1 stack remains MkDocs-centered with project-local docs tooling.
No DOC-M41 install, download, scaffold, root site rebuild, browser proof or publication action was performed.
unsupported_claims: Structurizr DSL is installed or verified
latest upstream versions or current official docs were checked
MkDocs is permanently sufficient for all future documentation needs
dependency safety or vulnerability-free status for deferred tools

accepted_gaps.gap: Official current Docusaurus, Storybook and Structurizr documentation was not refreshed
accepted_gaps.reason: DOC-M41 is a local trigger-governance record; network research and install decisions require a separate approved slice
accepted_gaps.residual_risk: Future trigger slices must verify current official documentation before selecting versions or install commands
accepted_gaps.follow_up: Refresh official docs when a trigger decision record is opened

accepted_gaps.gap: No prototype platform scaffold was created
accepted_gaps.reason: The current evidence does not justify adding another docs platform
accepted_gaps.residual_risk: Platform fit remains untested until a concrete trigger appears
accepted_gaps.follow_up: Create an approved prototype only after requirement evidence exists

accepted_gaps.gap: No root site rebuild or browser proof was run
accepted_gaps.reason: DOC-M41 changes source-owned trigger records only
accepted_gaps.residual_risk: Generated site freshness and browser behavior remain unclaimed
accepted_gaps.follow_up: Run the separate approved site or browser proof slice when needed
